The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8200` (see `VaultBuilder.VaultPort`)
- Environment variable: `VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID=root` (see `VaultBuilder.WithRootToken(string)`)
- Environment variable: `VAULT_TOKEN=root` (see `VaultBuilder.WithRootToken(string)`)
- Environment variable: `VAULT_ADDR=http://0.0.0.0:8200`
- Create parameter: `HostConfig.CapAdd=["IPC_LOCK"]`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /v1/sys/health` to port `8200` is completed successfully.
- Startup callback: Runs the configured Vault CLI init commands.
